origin.packaging: Unmodified bytes extracted from the official release APK; APK SHA-256 matches GitHub release asset digest.
origin.licenseScope: README.md:61 licenses all code outside deps/ under MIT. Only the standalone tawcroot executable is imported; not the GPLv3 app.

runtimeContract.environment: Guest inherits envp directly (main.c:504). No PRoot loader variables or LD_PRELOAD are required. No CLI cwd, UID or environment flags; change directory in the guest shell.
runtimeContract.documentationCaveat: v6 notes/tawcroot/bootstrap-and-modules.md:21 mentions -w, but the actual production parser rejects it.

mainComparison.result: Both files byte-identical to main when retrieved; this does not imply the complete source trees are identical.

runtimeContract.buildEvidence: tawcroot/build.sh builds a freestanding static non-PIE ET_EXEC and stages it as libtawcroot.so.
runtimeContract.packaging: armsolo jniLibs; useLegacyPackaging=true; keepDebugSymbols prevents binary stripping.

compatibility.evidence: v6 notes/distro-options.md:177 calls Ubuntu technically viable. This is not an Ubuntu 24.04 runtime test. The glibc-only distribution constraint at :67 is motivated by libhybris graphics integration, not proof that all musl programs fail in tawcroot.
compatibility.smokePrerequisites: Run from an Android app context on API >=29, arm64 64-bit process, with NATIVE_DIR=applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir and ROOTFS=the installed Ubuntu rootfs absolute path. A successful shell smoke does not validate PTY, DNS, all workloads or all devices.
compatibility.smokeExpected: Exit 0, a glibc version, tawcroot-stdin and tawcroot-smoke-ok. Then verify interactive PTY and disabling tawcroot on the target app. No automatic retry of failed commands.
